title: onprem-client-weekly-cadence-notes-emma
agenda:
1) Quick status rundown (3m each owner)
2) Blockers deep-dive: networking, drivers, KMS
3) Rollout window confirmation and blackout windows
4) Action items and owners
5) Open questions / next sync cadence
notes:
Brief notes before sync: Project Greenfield is approaching the first customer-directed cutover window. Last week we validated model artifact ingestion (quantized v2) but hit two infra regressions on GPU driver & NFS mounts. Customer wants a hard go/no-go by next Tue (2026-03-17). Keep this sync focused—avoid design-level debates, escalate to PM sync for scope changes.

Status snapshot:
- Model artifacts: ingestion OK, size 6.3GB (quantized), staging validation 95% pass on unit prompts. (Sofia)
- Runtime: CVM instances provisioned in customer VPC; autoscaler tests green but slow cold-start due to missing init image layer cache. (Raj)
- Networking: VPN peering established; BGP flaps observed on customer edge during stress test. (Tom)
- Security: KMS key rotation pending; customer requires HSM-backed key for production. (Priya)
- Observability: Traces and logs streaming to customer Splunk; an alert threshold for long-tail latency needs tuning. (Liam)
blockers: GPU driver mismatch on customer GPU nodes causing segfaults - JIRA-INFRA-8421 (owner: Raj)
Init container image too large -> cold-start > 12s; impacts canary SLA (owner: Sofia)
BGP session instability during high-load peering tests - ticket JIRA-NET-773 (owner: Customer network team, need joint triage)
KMS/HSM integration: customer requires HP HSM profile -> Redwood needs integration plan (owner: Emma + Security)
Firewall/NAT egress rules: blocked artifact download from S3 mirror in customer subnet (owner: Joe/customer)
action_items: Raj: Produce short remediation plan for GPU driver mismatch and version pinning by 2026-03-14 (include rollback steps and test checklist)
Sofia: Build a slim init image (strip optional tooling) and run cold-start benchmark; target <8s by 2026-03-15
Liam: Adjust alert for 99.9th percentile token latency and add a synthetic probe for prefix-cache warmup by 2026-03-13
Emma: Coordinate HSM requirements doc with customer security and schedule 1h vendor call by 2026-03-16
Tom & Raj: Joint triage session on BGP flaps (invite network team + cloud provider rep) scheduled 2026-03-13 14:00 PT
Priya: Share formal acceptance criteria doc for production cutover and blackout windows by 2026-03-13
All: Confirm who owns runbook sections: deploy, rollback, diagnostics by EOD 2026-03-12
decisions:
- Proceed to staged canary if GPU driver plan is approved; otherwise postpone cutover.
- Use customer HSM for production keys; Redwood to own integration but customer to validate compliance.
- Weekly cadence will remain on Fridays 09:00 PT until cutover, switch to daily standups if blockers persist.
open_questions: Can customer provide a spare node set to reproduce GPU failure in their env?
Are there any P0 compliance items for HSM certs that would prevent next-week go-live?
Who will own emergency incident comms during cutover window? (Redwood oncall vs customer ops)
quick_todo: Today before sync: skim linked Confluence page, flag any acceptance criteria mismatches, send short pre-read to attendees (2 bullets).
retrospective_comments: Sketch for later: reduce init image size by splitting optional tools into sidecar; consider lazy-pull of model shards to reduce cold-start impact.
